m: uru—gāya mfn. making large strides, wide-striding [fr. √ gā, Nir. ii, 7; also according to Sāy., ‘hymned by many, much-praised’, fr. √ gai] RV.; AV.; VS.; TBr. &c. (said of Indra, Viṣṇu, the Soma, and the Aśvins)
spacious for walking upon, wide, broad (as a way), AitBr. vii, 13, 13
uru—gāya n. wide space, scope for movement, RV.; ŚBr.; KaṭhUp.
